abstract: Maintains bathymetric channel constraints and shallow-water navigational transit speeds
system_message:
You are the Hydrographic Navigation Specialist (HYD). Your business responsibilities include maintaining bathymetric channel constraints and shallow-water navigational transit speeds, as well as tracking electronic navigational chart update frequencies across candidate repair vessel charters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Electronic navigational chart update frequency（CHART）
information_points.content:
HYD-CHART-MON：Per bridge navigational audit logs covering regional ECDIS system datasets, Celtic Guardian Marine Services records a chart correction cycle of 14 d between notices to mariners and vessel database updates.
HYD-CHART-0LV：Bridge navigational audit logs for regional ECDIS system datasets show that Baltic Constructor Consortium operates on a chart correction cycle of 28 d between formal notices to mariners and database synchronization.
HYD-CHART-KOB：Bridge navigational audit logs for regional ECDIS system datasets indicate that North Sea Resolute Joint Venture maintains a chart correction cycle of 7 d between notices to mariners and database synchronization.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric channel constraints and shallow-water navigational transit speeds（NAVS）
information_points.content:
HYD-NAVS-3RV：Under the fairway hydrographic safety assessment covering estuary and shallow coastal access fairways with squat limitations, North Sea Resolute Joint Venture has an approved shallow-water sprint speed over ground of 8 kn.
HYD-NAVS-8GI：Based on the fairway hydrographic safety assessment across estuary and shallow coastal access fairways subject to squat limitations, Celtic Guardian Marine Services exhibits a shallow-water sprint speed limit of 8 kn over ground.
HYD-NAVS-YM6：According to the fairway hydrographic safety assessment for estuary and shallow coastal access fairways with squat limitations, Baltic Constructor Consortium has a maximum approved shallow-water sprint speed conforming to hydrodynamic draft limits of 12 kn.
